title: Phase 8: Messaging CoAP resource (/messages)
description: Add /messages to the Python node CoAP server. POST to send a text message (CBOR: {from, to, text, t}). GET returns recent inbox. Observable for push delivery. 'to' can be a peer EUI-64 or the broadcast address. Messages are forwarded over RPL if the destination is not a direct neighbour.
